thread:
alex: Quick flag — noticed a weird line on Feb invoice: ~16k of egress tagged to the wrong project. Looks like the provider split the same bytes between `prod-gpu` and `infra-billing` so it doubled our reported egress. attaching csv excerpt below and a console link.

maria: Ugh. Can you paste the CSV snippet here? FYI finance needs the provider ticket for credits.

sameer: If it's a metadata/tagging issue on provider side, they sometimes create two lineitems when both subnet and VPC tags are present. Haven't seen both duplicated for the same bytecount before though.

alex: CSV excerpt: 
```
InvoiceLineItemId,SKU,Description,UsageStart,UsageEnd,UsageAmount,Unit,Cost,Metadata
li-0a1b2c,NETWORK_EGRESS,Network egress: us-west1->external,2026-02-01,2026-02-01,1024000,bytes,8000,"project=prod-gpu,subnet=worker-prod"
li-0d3e4f,NETWORK_EGRESS,Network egress: us-west1->external,2026-02-01,2026-02-01,1024000,bytes,8000,"project=infra-billing,vpc=vpc-prod"
```

alex: Same usage amount, identical timestamps, two lineitems, cost duplicated. Total shows 16k.

jen: Did we recently change any labels/auto-tagging on subnets or VPCs? Could be an infra deploy that added both `project` and `vpc` labels at once.

sameer: We rolled out the subnet tagging script on 2026-01-30; it adds both `project` and `vpc` labels for traceability. I can grep flow logs to confirm which resource actually emitted the traffic.

patrick: Also check commitment/CUD consumption math — if traffic was attributed to infra project it might have missed reserved capacity offsets and triggered full on-demand pricing for that slice. That could double-cost impact even if provider credits the duplicate later.

maria: Finance: please open a provider support ticket immediately. We need a refund and a corrected invoice. Include the two lineitem ids and the CSV snippet. I can escalate once we have the ticket id.

sameer: Running quick query against netflow: `SELECT bytes, src_resource, tags FROM netflow WHERE date='2026-02-01' AND dst='external' AND bytes=1024000` — will post results in 10m.

billing-bot: Automated alert: provider billing schema change detected on 2026-02-01. Affected SKUs: NETWORK_EGRESS. Recommend human review.

alex: Noted. Also worth looping in cloud-ops to see if provider started emitting both `resource.tag.project` and legacy `vpc` keys in exported billing metadata.

jen: cc @sameer can you also check our cost allocation rules? If we see both tags present, our pipeline might be double-counting when building internal chargebacks.

sameer: quick grep results: found 3 events matching the exact bytecounts. src_resource=nic-23, tags=[project=prod-gpu,vpc=vpc-prod]. So the VM had both tags. It looks like provider created two lineitems because exported cost mapping picks up both tag keys separately.

maria: Filing ticket now. Provider support ticket created: #SUP-99271. Requesting corrected invoice and full reversal for duplicate lineitem li-0d3e4f. Linking ticket: https://billing.provider.com/support/99271

patrick: Until provider corrects, we should exclude duplicate lineitems from internal chargeback calculations to avoid double-charging product teams. I'll put a short-term filter in the pipeline to dedupe on (usage_start,usage_end,bytes,destination).

alex: Good plan. Maria, please request retroactive usage attribution to `prod-gpu` only (keep the one lineitem) and ask for refund on the duplicate.

maria: Done. I asked for a formal audit of their tagging export and whether this is a broader regression for Feb. They acknowledged and put a P1 on it.

jen: I pushed a quick fix to our cost ETL to dedupe exact-match duplicates and added a warning counter (alert if >100 duplicates/day). Patch: `scripts/cost_etl/dedupe.py` updated.

sameer: Also adding a cluster-side label hygiene check to ensure we don't accidentally add both legacy and canonical tags. PR in infra repo: https://git.redwood/infra/labels/pull/472

maria: Finance will hold any internal chargeback resets until provider issues a corrected invoice or confirmed credit. Will update when ticket moves.

alex: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: provider ticket id in 24h, ETL filter deployed (patrick), infra label PR merged (sameer), finance holds chargebacks (maria). :thumbsup:
